scope: Flat Minkowski diamonds; known d and T; iid uniform backgrounds; fixed independent marks; conditional error only
implementation_test_description: Two-sided exact binomial test of total interval count
Two-sided exact binomial test of coverage against finite-sum model coverage
multiple_test_method: Bonferroni over all 48 predeclared implementation tests
full_order_crosscheck: First realization in each m=256 cell: count from full squared-cone relation, validate strict poset, compare existing d=2 feature extractor
stopping_rule: One fixed run. No seed replacement or parameter tuning. Failed implementation gate is INCONCLUSIVE_FOR_IMPLEMENTATION, not a refutation of the theorem.
exclusions: No application or speed advantage claim
No qualification under unknown sampling laws
No claim of external preregistration or independent replication
